chars: the American driver
the friend in the dark print shirt
moments.action: A yellow coupe idles beside a silver Skyline on a neon street; inside, the American at the wheel and his friend trade words until both are grinning, then an overhead shot shows the cars pulling away.

chars: the friend in the pink hoodie
the American driver
moments.action: Daylight mountain pull-out: the friend in the pink hoodie briefs the American beside a red Evo while a crew lounges by a green van. POV runs of the empty hairpin road cut in, and the American turns to the car.

chars: the American driver
moments.action: Aerials catch the red Evo sweeping the clifftop hairpin, then it drifts past camera with the harness-strapped driver sawing at the wheel. It slides back into the pull-out and dust swallows the watching crew.

chars: the American driver
the young man in the red beanie
moments.action: Cut to a packed daytime shopping street: the American and the young man in the red beanie push through a crowd of costumed girls, then corner a heavyset man and start pitching to him.

chars: the American driver
the young man in the red beanie
moments.action: The sale closes - a whip-pan onto the hawker shouting, goods handed to a big man in a maroon cap and gold chain - and the pair stroll off through the shoppers, the red-beanie kid thumbing a roll of cash.

chars: the friend in the pink hoodie
the American driver
the young man in the red beanie
moments.action: Back on the mountain the crew watches from the bank with the friend in the pink hoodie standing apart; then a jump to a school crowd where the American walks in uniform shirt beside his friend in a bandana.

chars: the American driver
the friend in the pink hoodie
moments.action: Night in the warm-lit garage: the American stocks the parts shelves, two of the crew eat in a lit doorway, and he glances back over his shoulder. Deeper inside, his friend talks over a red couch and a grinning man leans in.

chars: the friend in the pink hoodie
moments.action: The first shot's frame is solid black and was not visually verified. Out of it the mountain pull-out returns: dust rolls over the seated crew and green van, and the friend in the pink hoodie stands arms folded, watching the road.

chars: the American driver
the young man in the red beanie
moments.action: Neon night street: the pair hawk sneakers to passers-by, a local slaps a high-five, and the American waves a banknote in his friend's face. They end up walking off shoulder to shoulder, both laughing.

chars: the friend in the pink hoodie
the American driver
moments.action: Riding shotgun in the Evo, the friend shouts instructions while the American wrenches the wheel and the car bucks. It cuts to the Evo drifting a dusk mountain curve, a boot stamping the pedal, then smoking through a dock yard.

chars: the American driver
the girl in the passenger seat
moments.action: Now a girl rides shotgun as the American drifts; low shots ride the front wheel and the Evo slews past the warehouses. It ends on two dock workers watching from the quay, one smirking around his cigarette.
